newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH SEPT WHOLESALES, RETAIL SALES RISE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH SEPT WHOLESALES, RETAIL SALES RISE.

text.p: The volume of Finnish wholesales rose 0.9 percent year-on-year in September and the value excluding value-added tax (VAT) of these sales rose 3.2 percent, Statistics Finland (SF) said a statement on Monday.
The volume of retail sales rose 1.0 percent year-on-year in September and the value excluding VAT of these sales rose 1.8 percent, SF said.
"In addition to automobile wholesales, September wholesales were boosted by raw materials wholesales and the other wholesales group," Statistics Finland said.
A six percent rise in the other wholesales group was accounted for mainly by trade in pharmaceuticals, laboratory and medical equipment, it said.
Fuel wholesales rose to the year-ago level, but September clothing wholesale volumes were lower than last year, it said.
In January-September, the volume of wholesales rose 1.6 percent and the retail volume 3.4 percent on the same period last year, it said.
